# Figure 1

**Source**: Figure 1 of the [paper](../paper.pdf), as identified in the inspection text below.

**Caption**: Power comparisons across the mixture, perturbed-uniform and galaxy settings. (paraphrase; original caption is preserved in the source PDF).

**Screenshot**: [figure1.png](figure1.png)

**Figure type**: quantitative_plot

**Extraction method**: digitized_estimate

**Reading confidence**: medium

**Axes**: The quantitative panels use linear axes; qualitative image panels have no numeric axes.

## Visual description

Type: quantitative_plot. Eight panels, linear axes throughout. Y is rejection proportion (“Power”), plotted from slightly below zero to slightly above one, ticks 0, 0.5, 1. X: top row is standard deviation sigma; perturbation amplitude a for d=1 and d=2; galaxy corruption probability c. Bottom row is sample size per sample. Main legend: MMD-FUSE, MMDAgg, MMDAggInc, ACTT, CTT, ME, SCF, MMD-D, AutoML, MMD-Median, MMD-Split. The Galaxy panels omit ME in plotting code and replace the generic deep-MMD source row with an image-specific deep-MMD row. No confidence intervals are displayed.

Caption states four experimental settings, first row size m=n=500; second-row deviations respectively sigma=1.3, a=0.2, a=0.4, c=0.15; averages over 200 repetitions. Mixture top x values are exactly `(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1, 1.2, 1.4, 1.6, 1.8, 2)` in author cell 4, bottom `(500,1000,1500,2000,2500,3000)` in cell 6. Mixture axes themselves label only selected ticks; do not interpolate omitted x labels as uniform spacing.

Visual readings: mixture power drops near the null sigma=1 and rises away from it; median-bandwidth MMD and CTT remain close to zero across the mixture sweep. Sample-size mixture curves generally rise; MMD-FUSE/MMDAgg are close, SCF can be competitive. Perturbed-uniform power rises with amplitude and size; FUSE and MMDAgg are near the upper envelope. In Galaxy size sweeps, image deep MMD overtakes FUSE/MMDAgg, so “highest in every setting” is false as an unqualified summary. Local mixture FUSE leftmost bottom point visually ≈0.18; exact retained author aggregate and local run are separate evidence, not pixel estimates.

Extraction method: `visual_description` plus `digitized_estimate` for visual values; `exact_from_labels` only for printed caption/ticks. Additional exact-from-notebook values must be labeled as a separate upstream output source. Reading confidence high for axes/order/trends; medium for interpolated points. Every non-mixture power point still requires transcription or explicitly approximate digitization for full quantitative coverage. A selected-mixture view must be named `derived_` or `subset_`, never stand in for the full Figure 1.

## Trend summary

The mixture median baseline remains near its low rejection rate while adaptive kernel collections react to local variance changes. The image panels have different rankings; the image-kernel MMD-D curve and the longer AutoML setting must not be conflated with the synthetic baselines. These are author-reported comparisons, not new local comparison runs.
